text:
hey guys here's the plan for the himachal trip 🏔️ (copied from the operator page, bus from Majnu ka Tilla 7pm volvo, dinner on the way at own cost)

Day 1 - overnight bus Delhi to McLeodganj
Day 2 - reach McLeodganj, check in. Bhagsu waterfall + Bhagsunag temple, then markets and tibetan cafes
Day 3 - after breakfast drive to Bir, monasteries and cafes. camp at Bir Billing, sunset, dinner, bonfire 🔥
Day 4 - paragliding at Bir Billing (weather permitting!!) then drive to Tirthan Valley, overnight in Tirthan
Day 5 - Jalori Pass, trek to Serolsar Lake. bonfire in the evening
Day 6 - morning trek to Choie waterfall then river rafting on Beas in Kullu. leave for Delhi in the evening
Day 7 - reach Delhi early morning, ~8-9am

pls carry warm clothes and ID. will share the payment link tmrw
note: Operator itinerary condensed and pasted in a chatty WhatsApp style, to test messy input.
